title: Repertoire at early dance jobs
summary: He played by ear and had to mix waltzes and jump numbers at dances.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Did you play everything by ear at that time or you had to do something? Oh yeah, yeah.
I was wondering what pieces of God would you play?
Did you play just the latest popular tunes or other waltzes or drag time or what kind of thing was it?
Oh at that time you had to play at that time, you had to play everything, you know, waltzes, people was dancing waltzes and a lot and... five shots and two steps and all.
Oh the latest tunes, I guess you knew those.
Yeah. At that time there was dancing waltzes a lot, you see. You had to mix them waltzes and you had to play two, three jump numbers and then waltzes. So we managed to make it.
